items.markdown:
![Bioethanol Fires UK | Clean, Vent Free Flames | Flames.co.uk](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09071512-1621-0139-0000-3352a57313c6:4)
A bioethanol fireplace `burns plant-based bioethanol fuel to create real flames without needing a chimney, flue, or gas line`.[](https://www.imaginfires.co.uk/collections/bioethanol-fireplace) [[1]](https://www.imaginfires.co.uk/collections/bioethanol-fireplace)[[2]](https://nef.org.uk/bioethanol-fires-a-good-or-bad-idea/)

### How It Works

- **Clean Burn:** Fuel inside a burner box produces real flames, heat, water vapour, and minimal carbon dioxide.
- **No Venting:** Absence of smoke, ash, or soot removes the requirement for a chimney.
- **Control:** Flames are manually or automatically ignited and adjusted via a sliding lid or remote.[](https://www.castfireplaces.co.uk/fireplace-packages/bioethanol-fireplaces/) [[1]](https://www.castfireplaces.co.uk/fireplace-packages/bioethanol-fireplaces/)[[2]](https://www.imaginfires.co.uk/collections/bioethanol-fireplace)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aTsFY8e78hg&t=157)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iP9nn1A71ng&t=13)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8154794772309628779,catalogid:5968461979754182164,gpcid:5278909922923777287,mid:576462524287238802&ibp=oshop)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=97IRXD4yGmk)

### Popular Styles & Pricing (UK)

- **Freestanding Stoves:** Portable units like the [[HOMCOM Freestanding Bioethanol Fireplace Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462563292665965,imageDocid:6241309062364325446,gpcid:16903209844065272156,headlineOfferDocid:3300540627055940853,catalogid:1115311082240239977,productDocid:18085136898603511085,rds:CSS_PC_16903209844065272156%7CPC_16903209844065272156%7CPROD_CSS_PC_16903209844065272156%7CPROD_PC_16903209844065272156&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj9laDX4NyWAxUxJzQIHfWCCp8Qxa4PegoIAggACAAIBRAd) ](https://www.robertdyas.co.uk/homcom-freestanding-bioethanol-fireplace-ethanol-fireplace-stove-with-12l-tank?srsltid=AfmBOoqs7h70yb17k5nsrjaMP9Fp35y2qcz1R4R5lO-UC3Etx7uViE8F5gk) cost around **£64–£85**.
- **Tabletop Fire Bowls:** Small decorative accents like the [Fallen Fruits Bioethanol Rectangular Garden Fireplace](https://www.johnlewis.com/fallen-fruits-bioethanol-rectangular-garden-fireplace-black/p114341160) cost about **£53**.
- **Built-in / Media Wall:** Inset designs like the [Double-Sided Bioethanol Fireplace from B&Q](https://www.diy.com/departments/double-sided-bioethanol-fireplace-in-black-27-inch-amberglo/5056793148189_BQ.prd?srsltid=AfmBOorTl5immUu4dJpEpYTppaWPFPOD9FAlc4zJ854XkV6fkF1nUVQr72M) range from **£180–£200**.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:18085136898603511085,catalogid:1115311082240239977,gpcid:16903209844065272156,mid:576462563292665965&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8478650298615528080,catalogid:7002513048957907767,gpcid:1478439613005030806,mid:576462606146113041&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8154794772309628779,catalogid:5968461979754182164,gpcid:5278909922923777287,mid:576462524287238802&ibp=oshop)

### Key Safety Rules

- **Never Refuel While Lit:** Wait until the fire is completely extinguished and the unit is fully cold before adding more fuel.
- **Use Proper Fuel:** Stick to dedicated bioethanol fuel with 95%–97.5% purity.
- **Ventilation:** Operate in a well-ventilated space appropriate for the size of the room and burner output.[](https://nef.org.uk/bioethanol-fires-a-good-or-bad-idea/) [[1]](https://nef.org.uk/bioethanol-fires-a-good-or-bad-idea/)[[2]](https://www.castfireplaces.co.uk/fireplace-packages/bioethanol-fireplaces/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TrIlCPMyi9U&t=69)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iP9nn1A71ng&t=13)

If you're looking to buy one, tell me:

- Do you want a **freestanding, tabletop, or wall-recessed/built-in** model?
- Is it meant for **indoor or outdoor** use?
- What is your target **budget**?

![Cremation Urns & Keepsakes - Matthews Aurora Funeral Solutions](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09071513-1621-0139-0000-f5cf95eca885:4)
An urn is `a tall, rounded vase with a base, most commonly used to hold the cremated ashes of a person or pet`.[](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/urn) [[1]](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/urn)

### Common Types and Uses

- **Funerary Urns:** Vessels designed to store cremated remains for burial, placement in a columbarium niche, or keeping at home.
- **Keepsake Urns:** Tiny vessels meant to hold a very small portion of ashes so multiple family members can share the remains.
- **Companion Urns:** Larger or double-capacity containers made to hold the combined ashes of two people.
- **Beverage Urns:** Large, functional metal containers equipped with a faucet used in catering to serve hot coffee or tea.
- **Decorative Urns:** Large ornamental vases used as architectural features or garden decorations rather than for holding remains.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urn) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urn)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11834459146765917171,catalogid:13625224247883954591,gpcid:6983482127312016873,mid:576462716237074245&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mIne6Xcz3wo&t=2)[[4]](https://urnsuk.com/)[[5]](https://urnswithlove.co.uk/)[[6]](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/urn)

### Materials and Pricing

- **Metals:** Such as brass and bronze, often durable and featuring threaded lids, generally ranging from **£25 to £130+** depending on the size and craftsmanship.
- **Wood and Ceramic:** Traditional handcrafted options suitable for home display or burial.
- **Biodegradable materials:** Paper or cardboard tubes designed specifically for scattering ashes.[](https://urnswithlove.co.uk/) [[1]](https://urnswithlove.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1575856263451109848,catalogid:2504789263444279336,gpcid:1641064994976476010,mid:576462850427963931&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11834459146765917171,catalogid:13625224247883954591,gpcid:6983482127312016873,mid:576462716237074245&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16798096115989461575,catalogid:8025722949879787237,gpcid:3843699291836063312,mid:576462305411843740&ibp=oshop)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mIne6Xcz3wo&t=2)

A recurve bow is `a type of bow with limbs that curve away from the archer at the tips when unstrung`.[](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/bn_16566972) [[1]](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/bn_16566972)

### Key Features

- **Curved Limbs:** The tips bend outward, storing more energy and releasing it more efficiently than straight-limbed bows.
- **Compact Size:** The recurve design delivers high arrow speed with a shorter overall length than a standard longbow.
- **No Pulleys:** Unlike compound bows, a recurve relies entirely on the archer's strength and the flexibility of the limbs.
- **Versatility:** It is the official style used in the [Olympic Games](https://www.worldarchery.sport/sport/equipment/recurve) and is popular for target archery, field archery, and traditional shooting.[](https://www.merlinarchery.co.uk/bows/recurve-bows.html) [[1]](https://www.merlinarchery.co.uk/bows/recurve-bows.html)[[2]](https://www.redfrogstore.co.uk/collections/traditional-recurve-bows)[[3]](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/bn_16566972)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jz2SrxbI8UI&t=91)

### Types of Recurve Bows

- **Traditional:** Classic, often one-piece wooden bows used without sights.
- **Olympic / Sporting:** High-tech setups featuring adjustable weights, stabilizers, and sights.
- **Take-down:** Bows that disassemble into three pieces (a riser and two limbs), making them easy to transport and upgrade.[](https://archery-shop.co.uk/recurve-bows) [[1]](https://archery-shop.co.uk/recurve-bows)[[2]](https://www.thelongbowshop.com/collections/recurve-bows)

If you are looking to buy or use a recurve bow, tell me:

- What is your **experience level** (complete beginner, intermediate)?
- What is your **intended use** (target practice, hunting, backyard fun)?
- Do you have a specific **budget** in mind?

items.markdown:
An ice bath is `a cold water immersion therapy where a person submerges their lower body or torso in water chilled to 10–15°C (50–59°F) for 5 to 15 minutes to help reduce muscle soreness and speed up physical recovery`.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_bath) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_bath)

### Key Benefits

- **Muscle recovery:** Constricts blood vessels and reduces inflammation or swelling after intense exercise.
- **Nervous system reset:** Triggers a stress response that releases endorphins, increases alertness, and can improve mood.
- **Stress relief:** Helps lower cortisol levels and promotes mental resilience through controlled breathing.[](https://oasis-odl.co.uk/product-category/ice-bath/) [[1]](https://oasis-odl.co.uk/product-category/ice-bath/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bf2blpi-bYM&t=112)[[3]](https://www.lidl.co.uk/c/ice-bathing-for-regeneration-how-to-get-started/s10082894)[[4]](https://gobanya.co.uk/facilities/ice-bath/)

### Safety Guidelines & Risks

- **Duration:** Limit sessions to 2–15 minutes. Staying in too long increases the risk of hypothermia.
- **Cold shock:** The initial 30 seconds cause rapid breathing and increased heart rate. Control your breathing carefully.
- **Medical restrictions:** Avoid ice baths if you have cardiovascular disease, high blood pressure, respiratory issues like asthma, or if you are pregnant.[](https://www.lidl.co.uk/c/ice-bathing-for-regeneration-how-to-get-started/s10082894) [[1]](https://www.lidl.co.uk/c/ice-bathing-for-regeneration-how-to-get-started/s10082894)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_bath)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0jMB8PvnA7Y&t=89)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4bYKyD5ZZzA&t=91)

### Getting Started at Home
If you want to try cold water immersion at home, you can use a budget-friendly portable option like the [[VEVOR Ice Bath Tub Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462808301678010,imageDocid:5385151855691995725,gpcid:12808231811003654536,headlineOfferDocid:13467716083250505542,catalogid:8578778483830348139,productDocid:15185383716332658527,rds:CSS_PC_12808231811003654536%7CPC_12808231811003654536%7CPROD_CSS_PC_12808231811003654536%7CPROD_PC_12808231811003654536&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiu-8S14tyWAxWP0QIHHXXCDy8Qxa4PegoIAggACAAIIBAG) ](https://www.amazon.co.uk/VEVOR-Athletes-Portable-Recovery-Inflatable/dp/B0DCJMVGLT) or [[Activpower Ice Bath Tub Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462892317630980,imageDocid:7419400114876095428,gpcid:11005010252720937835,headlineOfferDocid:10268601614672081256,catalogid:11668406595578656320,productDocid:16596181437847460476&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiu-8S14tyWAxWP0QIHHXXCDy8Qxa4PegoIAggACAAIIBAJ) ](https://www.diy.com/departments/activpower-ice-bath-tub-portable-cold-plunge-for-adults-415l-with-cover-pump-drainage-kit-and-insulation-layer/5061020193283_BQ.prd) (both priced around £40–£45). Start with slightly cooler showers or warmer cold water (around 15°C) before working your way down.[](https://www.lidl.co.uk/c/ice-bathing-for-regeneration-how-to-get-started/s10082894) [[1]](https://www.lidl.co.uk/c/ice-bathing-for-regeneration-how-to-get-started/s10082894)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15185383716332658527,catalogid:8578778483830348139,gpcid:12808231811003654536,mid:576462808301678010&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16596181437847460476,catalogid:11668406595578656320,gpcid:11005010252720937835,mid:576462892317630980&ibp=oshop)If you'd like, let me know:

A cold plunge tub is `a small tub filled with cold water (usually 5°C to 15°C) used for muscle recovery, reduced inflammation, and improved circulation`.[](https://www.edenhut.co.uk/cold-plunge-tub) [[1]](https://www.edenhut.co.uk/cold-plunge-tub)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17531262127584425341&ibp=oshop)

### Types and Pricing

- **Inflatable / Portable Pods:** Budget-friendly options like the [[Lay-Z-Spa Glacial Dip Ice Bath Pod Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462878798416928,imageDocid:3000762865926965718,gpcid:3947031053017338366,headlineOfferDocid:934004521456682895,catalogid:11065637627111310541,productDocid:7262113539073807136,rds:CSS_PC_3947031053017338366%7CPC_3947031053017338366%7CPROD_CSS_PC_3947031053017338366%7CPROD_PC_3947031053017338366&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi-1bu34tyWAxWFK_sDHZ68Da0Qxa4PegoIAggACAAIBxAO) ](https://www.very.co.uk/lay-z-spa-glacial-dip-ice-bath-cold-plunge-recovery-pod-with-pump/1601218863.prd?variantId=WRG26&srsltid=AfmBOoq2I6u-n6jvQanFM5Y6TPMUgJOXbDMnofRd01QlP67raTJdqEMhZgI) cost around £70 to £130 and require manual ice or a separate pump.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16534997082989910653,catalogid:8058353299564475312,gpcid:3841043399526123015,mid:576462877546201357&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7262113539073807136,catalogid:11065637627111310541,gpcid:3947031053017338366,mid:576462878798416928&ibp=oshop)
- **Self-Chilling Units:** High-end, plumbed acrylic or metal units with integrated chillers and digital temperature controls (such as the [[Outdoor Living Glacier Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:2491767713057983448,headlineOfferDocid:17531262127584425341,productDocid:17531262127584425341&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi-1bu34tyWAxWFK_sDHZ68Da0Qxa4PegoIAggACAAIBxAV) ](https://www.outdoorlivinghottubs.co.uk/products/outdoor-living-glacier?currency=GBP&country=GB&variant=55497132638591&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=Google%20Shopping&stkn=301203e31084) or premium global brands) range from £3,500 upwards.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17531262127584425341&ibp=oshop)

### Key Benefits

- **Faster Recovery:** Cold water immersion constricts blood vessels and decreases metabolic activity, reducing muscle swelling and breakdown.
- **Mental Resilience:** Short exposure to extreme cold triggers the release of endorphins and norepinephrine, boosting alertness and stress tolerance.[](https://www.edenhut.co.uk/cold-plunge-tub) [[1]](https://www.edenhut.co.uk/cold-plunge-tub)
- **Better Circulation:** Regular contrast or cold exposure helps train your cardiovascular system.[](https://www.edenhut.co.uk/cold-plunge-tub) [[1]](https://www.edenhut.co.uk/cold-plunge-tub)

If you'd like to narrow down your options, let me know:

- What is your **budget**?
- Do you prefer a **portable inflatable pod** or a **permanent self-chilling tub**?
- Will it be used **indoors or outdoors**?

A metal detector is `an electronic tool that makes a sound or signal when it gets close to metal`.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metal_detector) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metal_detector)

### What They Do

- **Find buried treasure:** People use them outdoors to search for lost coins, old rings, and historical relics.
- **Security checks:** Walk-through or handheld metal detectors scan people at airports or event entries to spot hidden weapons.
- **Industrial uses:** Construction workers use them to find hidden pipes or wires in walls.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metal_detector) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metal_detector)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15736188503207500768,catalogid:691558781374809265,gpcid:4392355314038262873,mid:576462498078181445&ibp=oshop)
